description: This is a source PHP class defining a method for registering plugins within the Smarty templating engine. The class, Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterPlugin, provides the registerPlugin() method to add plugins to Smarty templates with validation and exception handling.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterPlugin
classes.description: A class encapsulating the registerPlugin method for Smarty plugins, enabling plugin registration with validation and error handling.

methods.name: registerPlugin
methods.description: Registers a plugin with Smarty, performing validation such as callable check and caching attribute constraints, and throws exceptions if invalid.
